# PKG Fiscal 2004 Financial Figures

## Key Figures
- **Net Sales (Change):** $154.6 million (documents/report.md)
- **Net Sales (2003):** $1,735.5 million (documents/report.md)
- **Net Sales (2004):** $1,890.1 million (documents/report.md)
- **Net Income (Loss) (2004):** $68.7 million (documents/report.md)

## Calculation of Net Sales Increase Percentage
To calculate the percentage increase in net sales from 2003 to 2004:

\[ \text{Percentage Increase} = \left( \frac{\text{Net Sales (2004)} - \text{Net Sales (2003)}}{\text{Net Sales (2003)}} \right) \times 100 \]

Substituting the values:

\[ \text{Percentage Increase} = \left( \frac{1,890.1 - 1,735.5}{1,735.5} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Increase} = \left( \frac{154.6}{1,735.5} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Increase} = 0.0891 \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Increase} = 8.91\% \]

Therefore, net sales increased by 8.91% from 2003 to 2004.

\[ \text{Percentage Increase} = \left( \frac{\text{Net Sales (2004)} - \text{Net Sales (2003)}}{\text{Net Sales (2003)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Increase} = 0.0891 \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Increase} = 8.91\% \]

Therefore, net sales increased by 8.91% from 2003 to 2004.
